title: VISIT: T+1 Welcome
subject: You're going to Medora. Here's how to plan it.
preheader: Where to stay, how to get here and what to see, for your visit on [[custom.acme_-_visit_date_next]].

props.html:
Hello [[FIRSTNAME OR "Friend"]],

Your tickets to the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library are set for [[custom.acme_-_visit_date_next]], and your entry time is on your ticket confirmation. Medora is a small town in a big landscape, so a little planning now makes the whole trip easier. Here is what to sort out first.

Thank you for coming as a member. Head for the member line when you arrive. Your membership also takes 25% off any extra admission tickets for friends, and 10% off in the Library Shop and at Salt+Scoria (excluding alcohol).

props.alt: Watch the preview: Discover the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library (3:35)
props.caption: A 3½-minute look at the galleries, the building, Medora and the national park

cols.alt: A horse-drawn carriage passes shops in downtown Medora
cols.heading: Where to Stay
cols.text: Medora has limited lodging, and summer weekends book up fast. See hotels, cabins, rentals and campgrounds with room on your dates, all in one place.
cols.label: Check Availability

cols.alt: The Library on the prairie above Medora
cols.heading: Getting Here
cols.text: Medora sits on I-94: Exit 24 from the west, Exit 27 from the east. A rental car is the way to see the Badlands. Coverage is spotty, so download your route before you go.
cols.label: Directions

cols.alt: Two children run along a ridge above the Badlands
cols.heading: Plan Your Days
cols.text: Allow about three and a half hours for the galleries, plus time for the boardwalk and the rooftop prairie. The Trip Planner builds a day-by-day route around your interests.
cols.label: Trip Planner

cols.alt: The Little Missouri River winding through the Badlands
cols.heading: The National Park
cols.text: Theodore Roosevelt National Park's South Unit entrance is right in town. A favorite plan: the scenic loop in the morning, the Library in the afternoon.
cols.label: Plan a Park Day

props.html: Want it all handled? One Medora packages bundle a hotel night, an evening show and Library admission in one booking.
Know someone who would love it here? As a member you take 10% off gift memberships.

Admission is $26 for adults and $16 for youth. A membership covers a full year of visits, and Individual and Dual pay for themselves on your second trip. Already have tickets? You don't lose them. The Library will refund your tickets and put what you paid toward a membership, and your reservation stays exactly as it is.

props.note: Every level adds the member line, 25% off extra admission tickets, and 10% off in the Library Shop and at Salt+Scoria. Save 10% more with auto-renew or two years.
